Reasoning: this combination of “large areas of desert and saline-alkali land, increases in cropland and forest-grassland, and decreases in water body and wetland” accords with the land-use change characteristics of oasis agricultural expansion in arid and semi-arid inland basins. Such regions in China are mainly distributed on the edges of basins in Xinjiang, among which the southern Junggar Basin has the characteristics of large areas of desert and saline-alkali land as well as oasis agricultural expansion in recent decades, so this region is most likely located in the southern Junggar Basin.
